comments.text:
🌊 Imagine falling asleep every night on land the sea was supposed to own. That is everyday life in the Netherlands, and in this Netherlands documentary you will see how the Dutch turned that danger into one of the most orderly countries on Earth. But behind the open curtains, the bikes and the quiet canals 🚲, there is a pressure many visitors never notice.
So what's your verdict? A model the world should copy, or a dream too fragile to last? Tell us in the comments 👇
